sources.summary: The existing async URL-based data API accepts a task delegate. Available on iOS15 and later; the Runtime package minimum is18.4.
The optional task-delegate callback provides collected metrics. Available on iOS10 and later. No guarantee of observed callback delivery is inferred when its count is zero.
Transactions provide request/response phase dates, reuse/proxy/protocol information, and counts. Incomplete phases may have absent end dates.
Detailed response-body counts are available from iOS13 and include framing/encoding overhead; they must not be blindly equated to decoded Data or Content-Length.
